observations: Used car engine and gearbox assembly.
The engine is mounted on a transmission housing.
The engine has a black plastic cover on the top, which is typical for a V8 engine.
The gearbox is attached to the engine via a metal bracket.
The engine is sitting on a dirt or gravel surface.
A watermark 'BLESSING FIELDS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The engine bay and the black plastic cover are consistent with a Lexus 460, but the brand name is not visible in the photo.
The gearbox is attached to the engine, but the specific model (3ur-v8) cannot be confirmed from the photo.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may not be a genuine Lexus 460 or may be a generic part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block stamped with the brand and model.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic or used engine

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a different model (e.g., 3ur-400) or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox's identification plate and a video of it being shifted through all gears.

risks.risk: The engine may be a used part from a different vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine stamped with the vehicle plate number.
risks.if_unproven: as a used engine from an unknown vehicle

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine block stamped with the brand and model.
Photo of the gearbox identification plate.
Photo of the engine stamped with the vehicle plate number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
